master: a Multivariate Axonal Simulator for Tractography Evaluation

Source: R/master-package.R
master-package.Rd

master is a generative simulator for white-matter fascicles used to build and evaluate tractography algorithms. It implements the FDA-based generative design:

Details

  1. a reference centerline (functional mean pathway) is assembled from a central straight interaction segment with smooth bending arms (generate_centerline());

  2. the centerline is discretized onto an equally spaced grid in curvilinear arc length (reparametrize_3D_curve());

  3. individual axons are drawn as the centerline plus a zero-mean functional random field: each coordinate is expanded in a B-spline basis whose Gaussian coefficients carry an exponential autocorrelation (create_axons()). Zero mean keeps the sample mean of the bundle on the true centerline.

The emitted objects use the fiber model (fiber::streamline, fiber::bundle, fiber::bundle_set) and drop straight into rtists::plot3d() for interactive visualization.
